summary: Virtu Financial filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 results (Item 2.02) and disclosing board approval of a planned reincorporation from Delaware to Texas (Item 8.01). On November 4, 2026, the board, on unanimous recommendation of a special committee, adopted a Plan of Conversion; controlling holder TJMT Holdings LLC approved it by written consent. Each share of Class A through D converts one-for-one into the corresponding Texas class at the effective time, with no change to economic terms or ownership. Not a special situation; watch for stockholder litigation over the controlling-holder consent and any appraisal or governance objections.
